Membership: request-ID namespaces and payload keys (which embed purpose) are disjoint; source IDs differ; the Train tape contains no Eval seed, source or prefix.
Provenance: this manifest pins the protocol, module and both tape SHA-256 values; verify regenerates byte-identically.

Unequal hashes alone are NOT claimed as holdout evidence. Both seeds are public, so this is a procedural holdout of synthetic draws from one public generator: not an OOD/generalization split and not an Azure or real-trace holdout.
